findings.claim: 10-K 載明公私付費方鼓勵使用學名藥替代品牌藥，美國多數情況下藥師可（或須）替代；部分國家智財保護弱，須與上市後不久的學名版本競爭。
findings.excerpt: Further, public and private payers typically encourage the use of generics as alternatives to branded products. Laws in the U.S. generally allow, and in many cases require, pharmacists to substitute generics that have been rated under government procedures to be essentially equivalent to a branded product.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子載明：AI 技術可能使競爭對手更快或更有效採用 AI 能力，且不保證 Lilly 的 AI 投資有效益。
findings.excerpt: The rapid advancement of these technologies presents opportunities for us in research, manufacturing, commercialization, and other business endeavors but also entails risks, including that AI-generated content, 34 analyses, or recommendations we utilize could be inadequate, or that our competitors may more quickly or effectively adopt AI capabilities.

findings.claim: Novo 口服 Wegovy 於 2025 年 12 月獲 FDA 核准、2026 年 1 月上市；Pfizer 收購 Metsera（最高 110 億美元，月注射 GLP-1）；Amgen MariTide 中期試驗體重減輕最多約 20%；Viking 口服 VK2735 計畫 2026 Q3 進入 Phase III。Lilly 口服 orforglipron（Foundayo）為第二個獲批的口服減重藥。
findings.source: Reuters Factbox（經 TimesLive 轉載）Weight-loss drug developers line up to tap lucrative market as competition heats up

findings.claim: Lilly 2025 年 4 月起控告遠距醫療業者販售複方（compounded）tirzepatide；2026-03-12 發出複方 tirzepatide 污染物警告；2026-06 與醫療中心就複方藥案提出撤銷訴訟。搜尋摘要稱 FDA 受理兩件 tirzepatide 學名藥 ANDA，來源品質低、未驗證。
findings.source: Mealey's：Lilly, Medical Centers File Stipulation Of Dismissal In Compounded Drug Row

substitute_technology.note: 僅執行 2 次搜尋；ANDA 說法未經一手來源證實。
